summary: Iter 90 — FULL end-to-end validation of the 2-step finalize wizard + OCR endpoint in the Lousa Mobile PWA. Reused iter89 pytest suite (test_iter89_ocr_sn_and_fotos.py — 7/7 PASS) covering OCR validation (empty/short/oversize/garbage rejected; valid base64 returns {sn,mac,confidence,raw_text,best}) and public_finalize fotos[] schema regression. NEW THIS ITER: live UI walkthrough — created a real instalacao ticket via admin API for col-30aafc3c, admin-opened it, then drove the technician PWA at /?cid=col-30aafc3c&mode=app. Verified: (a) finalize-steps renders 'ETAPA 1/2'; (b) Step 1 shows finalize-sinal, finalize-ont, ocr-sn-btn, equip-photo-section, finalize-next-btn — and HIDES finalize-obs/finalize-back-btn/finalize-btn; (c) photo-required-modal opens when Próximo clicked without equip photo (and step stays at 1); (d) after equip-photo-input upload, Próximo advances to ETAPA 2/2; (e) Step 2 shows FTTH + REDE sections separated visually, finalize-obs, finalize-back-btn, finalize-btn; (f) clicking Voltar preserves form (ont='ALCLFC090E99TEST', sinal=-25, photo preview persists); (g) forward returns to step 2. ALL data-testid required by spec are present & wired.

minor.issue: Returns confidence='baixa' on null/null outputs — consider 'none' for clarity. LOW.

ui_bugs.issue: Backend still requires >= 3 fotos for type='instalacao' but wizard collects at most 2 (equipamento + SN). When finalize-btn is clicked on an instalacao ticket the backend returns 400 'Instalação exige no mínimo 3 fotos'. HIGH PRIORITY — wizard final step will fail for instalacao. Fix options: (a) lower backend min to 1 (equip photo is already mandatory client-side), (b) extend wizard to collect 3+ photos, (c) only enforce when type != instalacao via new wizard.
Modal has no explicit Cancel/Close button — only dismisses via backdrop tap or via the 'Abrir câmera agora' file input. Minor UX issue but not blocking; backdrop click does dismiss it. LOW.

issues: FTTH (border yellow #fde68a) and Rede (blue #bfdbfe) are clearly separated visually; Drop/Esticador/Conector fast under FTTH, Cabo rede/Conector rede under Rede. Layout is clean on 390px viewport.

action_items: [HIGH] Fix the instalacao-needs-3-fotos mismatch in routes/lousa.py L1180 & L1485 OR extend the wizard to capture ≥3 photos. Reproduction: create instalacao ticket → walk wizard → submit → 400 'Instalação exige no mínimo 3 fotos'.
[LOW] Add explicit Cancel button in photo-required-modal (backdrop dismiss works but a Cancel button improves accessibility).
[LOW] Consider adding a visible thumbnail of the SN photo (kind='sn') alongside the equipamento preview after captureSnPhoto succeeds.
[LOW] OCR confidence='baixa' on null detections is misleading — use 'none' or omit.
critical_code_review_comments: LousaMobile.js goToStep2 (L833-846) — correctly gates step transition on MAC presence + equip photo. Good.
LousaMobile.js photo-required-modal (L1234) — backdrop tap closes via onClick={() => setShowPhotoWarn(false)}, inner div uses e.stopPropagation. Works.
LousaMobile.js step state persistence — form is React state local to TicketDetail. Voltar→Next preserves all fields including form.fotos. Verified live.

routes/lousa.py public_ocr_sn (L2105+) — clean: size validation → base64 decode → Gemini 2.5 Flash via emergentintegrations LlmChat → robust JSON parse with code-fence strip + MAC normalization. Solid.

routes/lousa.py L1180 + L1485 — DUPLICATE 3-fotos validation in both /lousa/public/tickets/{id}/finalize and /lousa/tickets/{id}/finalize. Should be DRYed into a helper, and reconciled with the new wizard's photo capacity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on wizard flow (Step1→Step2→Voltar→Step2) — verified live via Playwright

Could not auto-delete (status=aberta blocks DELETE 409; admin-close needs richer payload than {outcome,notes}). Main agent should clean it up manually if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard 2-step UI is fully functional and all data-testid wired. The HIGH-priority remaining issue is the 3-fotos backend rule that will block the final submit for instalacao tickets. To reproduce: open ticket tkt-29199e719f in PWA (cid=col-30aafc3c), complete wizard with equip photo, click Finalizar — expect 400 from public_finalize_ticket. Test PNG b64 string TINY_PNG_B64 in test_iter89_ocr_sn_and_fotos.py works as upload data. Iter89 backend pytest re-ran clean (8.35s).
rca of the issue: All wizard transitions/data-persistence/modal-trigger logic is correct. The single structural risk is the 3-fotos requirement enforced server-side for type='instalacao' (lousa.py L1180/L1485) versus the wizard's design which collects 1 (equipamento) + optionally 1 (sn from OCR) = at most 2 dataUrls. Mitigation: lower the min to 1 (the wizard already enforces equip photo client-side via photo-required-modal), or extend the wizard to collect comprovante/before/after shots.
